title: Discrete q-Hermitian Clifford analysis
summary: We develop a discrete $q$-Hermitian Clifford calculus based on coordinatewise Jackson differences on multiplicative $q$-lattices. The resulting Hermitian Jackson--Dirac operators are nilpotent, factor a $q$-Laplacian, and have occupancy-dependent Euler anticommutators. These give explicit Fischer projectors and homotopies, but the local calculus is not controlled by total degree. We prove a two-face Cauchy--Kovalevskaya theorem for polynomials and extend it to a $q$-analytic Jackson--Fischer class.
